notes: «عن أبيه» is the father of Mu'tamir, named only by relation. He passes the report on to Abu Uthman: «قال وحدث أبو عثمان أيضا عن عبد الرحمن» read as one route, not a second isnad.
If «أيضا» were read as a second isnad, that route would start at معتمر; the text does not say so, so it is not written as one.
